decision.observation: 9:30 pm, Sat. 6; the bobber floats in the pond at ~(0.62,0.72) with the line from the rod. Message: 'You feel sluggish from over-exertion.' Energy bar is depleted (red).
decision.hypothesis: Exhaustion doesn't stop fishing; a bobber dip/'HIT!' cue followed by a C press has produced catches twice today.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6). Energy exhausted but casting still works.
